data.name: Adelaida
data.gender_notes: Adelaida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Adelaida is derived from the Germanic elements 'adal' meaning 'noble' and 'hild' meaning 'battle'. It was popular among the European nobility, particularly in Germany and Spain. The name Adelaida carries the meaning “Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adelaida usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of nobility and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Adelaida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelaida total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אדליידה
in_hebrew.meaning: אדליידה היא שם שפירושו אצילה ומיוחדת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדליידה היא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ופירושו אצילה ומיוחדת. השם נגזר מהמילים 'adal' שפירושו אציל ו-'heid' שפירושו סוג או מיוחדת. השם אדליידה היה נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים בימי הביניים והוא עדיין בשימוש כיום.

in_greek.name: Αδελαΐδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Αδελαΐδα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει Ευγενής και Ιδιαίτερη. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'adal' που σημαίνει Ευγενής και 'heid' που σημαίνει είδος ή Ιδιαίτερη. Το όνομα Αδελαΐδα ήταν δημοφιλές μεταξύ των χριστιανών κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και εξακολουθεί να χρησιμοποιείται σήμερα.

in_latin.name: Adelaida
in_latin.long_meaning: Adelaida is a Christian name derived from the Germanic language, meaning Noble and Distinguished. The name originates from the words 'adal' meaning noble and 'heid' meaning kind or distinguished. Adelaida was a popular name among Christians during the Middle Ages and remains in use today.

in_english.name: Adelaida
in_english.meaning: Adelaida means noble and distinguished, a name of Germanic origin

data.cultural_impact: The name Adelaida was taken up by various European royal dynasties, and several queens, princesses, and noblewomen were named Adelaida. It evokes images of power, nobility, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Adelaida can be seen as a reminder of the battle for spiritual purity and nobility. The name signifies the strength and courage required to fight the internal temptations and external challenges to our faith. The name Adelaida can inspire us to strive towards spiritual growth, struggle against our weaknesses, and remain steadfast in our commitment to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adelaida: Noble, Wealth, or Prosperous in Nobility. A name derived from the Germanic 'Adal' meaning noble and 'hild' meaning battle or strife. This name evokes the image of a strong, noble woman who has overcome adversity to attain prosperity and success.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Germanic origin, related to Old High German 'adal' (noble) and 'heid' (kind, sort) The name Adelaida carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
